reasons.why: This matches the reference's delivery claim.

reasons.reason: Delivery beats a shared CLAUDE.md in its own tests (99.5%; table of 100%, 87.4%, 70.9%, 32.2%; 18–29% own-model share)
reasons.why: The evidence map gives 70.6% for .claude/rules (D7) and 31.5% / 27.0% own-model share (D12), contradicting 70.9% and 18–29%.

reasons.reason: No measured gain in task success (588-run pilot; about 7% vs 19% cost)
reasons.why: R8 shows 600 of 600 runs passed with or without rules, which supports no gain; the pilot figures are not in the map and fail nothing.

reasons.reason: Only some rules have a measured effect: verify rules 30/30 and 27/30 vs 0/30 at 46–59% more cost, Sonnet carry-through 9 to 32 of 40, Fable report rule shortened sentences, Haiku carry-through no effect
reasons.why: 30/30 and 27/30 are the preset-rules arm (R1), not verify alone (R3: 29/30), and R6/R7 put the cost increase at about 57–120%, not 46–59%.

reasons.reason: The default preset is mostly dormant in interactive use
reasons.why: This matches L4: nothing on Opus or Fable, and only verify-changes on Sonnet and Haiku after a code-edit.

reasons.reason: It is pre-release (0.0.1, private, installed from a clone; found failures were fixed without a rerun)
reasons.why: This matches L7 and L5.

reasons.reason: Low-risk to try: hooks never deny, use local files only, have no runtime dependencies and write a decision log
reasons.why: The reference says noonsight never blocks, uses no network by default, has no runtime dependencies and keeps a decision log.

false_claims: .claude/rules covered 70.9% of requests (D7: 70.6%)
only 18–29% of the text a model read under CLAUDE.md was written for it (D12: 31.5% for CLAUDE.md)
the verify rules alone made Sonnet and Haiku run tests 30 of 30 and 27 of 30 (that is the preset-rules arm; verify alone was 29 of 30 per R3)
the verify rules cost 46–59% more on small tasks (R6/R7 imply about 57–120%)
hooks add roughly 60–120 ms per hook event (D15: 50 to 90 ms)
